purpose: Capture one unhandled-exception dump from the FACETS 4.5.0 bundled example so that repair decisions can be based on the faulting module rather than speculation.

execution.process_environment_change: TEMP and TMP point to a new empty child directory for ProcDump and FACETS
execution.specification_change: none; the bundled file is copied byte-for-byte

decision_rule.diagnostic_capture_pass: at least one nonempty .dmp file is created
decision_rule.scientific_authorization: never; the capture does not authorize supplemental calibration or endpoint reading

claim_boundary: Native crash diagnosis only; no scientific endpoint is read and no FACETS result is substituted.
